terms.definitionEn: A property that chooses the scheme used to place an element.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتختار نظام تحديد مكان العنصر.

terms.definitionEn: The default placement behavior where an element follows normal flow and inset offsets do not move it.
terms.definitionAr: طريقة الوضع الافتراضية اللي بتتبع التدفق الطبيعي وإزاحات الجهات ما بتحركش العنصر.

terms.definitionEn: A scheme that offsets an element from its normal-flow position while retaining its original layout space.
terms.definitionAr: نظام بيزحزح العنصر من مكانه الطبيعي مع الاحتفاظ بمساحته الأصلية في التخطيط.

terms.definitionEn: A scheme that removes an element from normal flow and positions it against a containing block.
terms.definitionAr: نظام بيشيل العنصر من التدفق الطبيعي وبيحطه بالنسبة لحاوية مرجعية.

terms.definitionEn: A scheme that removes an element from normal flow and normally anchors it to the viewport.
terms.definitionAr: نظام بيشيل العنصر من التدفق الطبيعي وغالبًا بيربطه بالـ viewport.

terms.definitionEn: A scheme that behaves like normal flow until a scroll threshold is reached within its scrolling context.
terms.definitionAr: نظام بيتبع التدفق الطبيعي لحد ما يوصل لحد تمرير داخل سياق التمرير بتاعه.

terms.definitionEn: A shorthand for setting the four physical top, right, bottom, and left offsets.
terms.definitionAr: اختصار لتحديد إزاحات الجهات الأربع: فوق ويمين وتحت وشمال.

terms.definitionEn: A property that sets a positioned box's stack level within its stacking context.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتحدد مستوى تكديس الصندوق داخل سياق التكديس بتاعه.

terms.definitionEn: A reference rectangle used to resolve some position offsets and percentage sizes.
terms.definitionAr: مستطيل مرجعي بيتستخدم لحساب بعض الإزاحات والأحجام بالنسبة المئوية.

terms.definitionEn: The default layout arrangement in which boxes participate in the document's ordinary flow.
terms.definitionAr: ترتيب التخطيط الافتراضي اللي الصناديق بتشارك فيه في تدفق المستند العادي.

terms.definitionEn: A self-contained layer group whose descendants are painted together relative to other groups.
terms.definitionAr: مجموعة طبقات مستقلة بيتترسم أبناؤها مع بعض بالنسبة للمجموعات التانية.

terms.definitionEn: A set of edge-offset properties that can locate a positioned box relative to its containing block.
terms.definitionAr: مجموعة خصائص إزاحة من الحواف ممكن تحدد مكان صندوق بالنسبة لحاويته المرجعية.

questions.question: How does top affect this statically positioned paragraph?
options: It does not offset the paragraph
It moves the paragraph down one rem
It fixes the paragraph to the viewport
It positions the paragraph against its parent
questions.explanation: Inset offsets do not apply to a statically positioned box.
questions.explanationAr: إزاحات الجهات ما بتأثرش على الصندوق اللي position بتاعه static.

questions.question: What happens to the tag's original layout space?
options: It is removed along with the tag
Its original space stays reserved
It becomes the size of the viewport
The entire box leaves normal flow and overlaps siblings
questions.explanation: Relative positioning offsets the box visually but leaves its original space in normal flow.
questions.explanationAr: relative بتحرك الصندوق بصريًا لكن بتسيب مساحته الأصلية في التدفق.

questions.question: Which box normally provides the containing block for the pin?
options: The viewport in every case
The nearest sibling with a border
The positioned card ancestor
The document's first element
questions.explanation: A positioned ancestor commonly establishes the containing block for an absolutely positioned descendant.
questions.explanationAr: العنصر الأب اللي عليه positioning غالبًا بيحدد الحاوية المرجعية للابن absolute.

questions.question: Which reference does fixed positioning normally use?
options: The nearest inline ancestor
The previous sibling's box
The normal-flow position only
The viewport
questions.explanation: Fixed positioning is normally relative to the viewport, unless an ancestor establishes a fixed-position containing block.
questions.explanationAr: fixed غالبًا بتكون بالنسبة للـ viewport، إلا لو ancestor عمل containing block خاص.

questions.question: What is the computed position value for the badge?
questions.explanation: The position declaration explicitly sets the value to relative.
questions.explanationAr: قاعدة position بتحدد القيمة relative صراحة.

questions.prompt: Restore ordinary default positioning for this paragraph.
questions.explanation: static is the initial position value and follows normal flow.
questions.explanationAr: static هي القيمة الابتدائية وبتتبع التدفق الطبيعي.

questions.prompt: Keep this badge in flow but move it down eight pixels.
questions.explanation: A positive top offset on a relatively positioned box moves it downward from its normal position.
questions.explanationAr: قيمة top موجبة مع relative بتحرك العنصر لتحت من مكانه الطبيعي.

questions.question: What does inset: 0 set in this shorthand?
options: All four edge offsets to zero
Only the top and left offsets
The element's width and height to zero
The z-index to zero
questions.explanation: The one-value physical inset shorthand sets top, right, bottom, and left to zero.
questions.explanationAr: القيمة الواحدة في inset بتحدد الجهات الأربع بصفر.

questions.question: When does a sticky header begin to stick?
options: Immediately, outside normal flow
At its scroll threshold
Only when it receives keyboard focus
Only after its z-index becomes positive
questions.explanation: A sticky box participates in flow and sticks when scrolling reaches its inset threshold within its scroll container.
questions.explanationAr: العنصر sticky بيشارك في التدفق ويلزق لما التمرير يوصل لحد الإزاحة داخل حاويته.

questions.code:
.back { position: relative; z-index: 2; }
.front { position: relative; z-index: 5; }
questions.question: Which sibling paints on top in the same stacking context?
options: back
Neither element
front
The earlier rule always wins
questions.explanation: Within the same stacking context, the larger integer stack level paints above the smaller one.
questions.explanationAr: داخل نفس stacking context، قيمة z-index الأكبر بتترسم فوق الأصغر.

questions.prompt: Remove this pin from normal flow and position it against its containing block.
questions.explanation: absolute positioning removes the box from normal flow and uses a containing block for offsets.
questions.explanationAr: absolute بتشيل الصندوق من التدفق الطبيعي وبتستخدم حاوية مرجعية للإزاحات.

questions.prompt: Keep this support control anchored to the viewport while scrolling.
questions.explanation: fixed positioning normally anchors the box to the viewport.
questions.explanationAr: fixed غالبًا بتثبت الصندوق بالنسبة للـ viewport.

questions.question: What does z-index: 4 control here?
options: The dialog's content width
The amount it moves from the top edge
The order of its text in normal flow
Its stack level
questions.explanation: z-index sets a stack level for the positioned box within its stacking context.
questions.explanationAr: z-index بتحدد مستوى الصندوق في التكديس داخل stacking context.

questions.prompt: Place this positioned alert at stack level 3.
questions.explanation: The integer z-index sets the stack level within the relevant stacking context.
questions.explanationAr: قيمة z-index الرقمية بتحدد مستوى التكديس داخل السياق.

questions.question: What role does top: 0 play for this sticky box?
options: It sets the sticky threshold
It removes the box from normal flow
It selects the nearest scroll container
It creates a stacking context by itself
questions.explanation: The inset supplies the threshold at which the sticky box is constrained during scrolling.
questions.explanationAr: قيمة الإزاحة بتحدد الحد اللي عنده العنصر sticky يبدأ يثبت أثناء التمرير.

questions.prompt: Stretch this absolute overlay to all four edges of its containing block.
questions.explanation: inset: 0 sets all four physical edge offsets to zero.
questions.explanationAr: inset: 0 بتحدد إزاحات الحواف الأربع بصفر.

questions.question: What is the fixed box's usual containing reference in this example?
options: The body padding box
viewport
The previous sibling
The nearest paragraph
questions.explanation: Without an ancestor establishing a fixed-position containing block, fixed positioning normally uses the viewport.
questions.explanationAr: من غير ancestor يعمل containing block لـ fixed، المرجع المعتاد هو viewport.

questions.code:
.outer { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.inner { position: relative; z-index: 999; }
questions.question: Can the inner element necessarily paint above a sibling of .outer with z-index: 2?
options: Yes, 999 always outranks every other layer in the document
Yes, positioning makes stacking contexts irrelevant
No; descendants stay within the ancestor context
No, because z-index only works on grid items
questions.explanation: A descendant cannot escape its ancestor's stacking context; the outer context's level is compared with sibling contexts.
questions.explanationAr: الابن ما يقدرش يخرج من stacking context الأب؛ مستوى السياق الخارجي هو اللي بيتقارن.

questions.prompt: Set this positioned modal above a sibling layer at level 2.
questions.explanation: A higher stack level paints above a lower sibling within the same stacking context.
questions.explanationAr: مستوى التكديس الأعلى بيتترسم فوق sibling أقل داخل نفس السياق.

questions.prompt: Stick the navigation bar to the top edge as its scroll container moves.
questions.explanation: A zero top inset sets the sticky threshold at the scroll container's top edge.
questions.explanationAr: إزاحة top بصفر بتخلي حد sticky عند الحافة العلوية لحاوية التمرير.

questions.question: Compare relative and absolute positioning in normal flow.
keyPoints: Relative boxes retain their original flow space
Absolute boxes are removed from normal flow
A positioned ancestor often contains absolute descendants
questions.modelAnswer: A relatively positioned box stays in normal flow and keeps its original space, even when offsets move it visually. An absolutely positioned box leaves normal flow and uses its containing block for offsets, often established by a positioned ancestor.
questions.explanation: The schemes differ in flow participation and offset reference.
questions.explanationAr: الفرق الأساسي في المشاركة بالتدفق الطبيعي والمرجع المستخدم للإزاحات.

questions.question: How do fixed and sticky positioning differ while a page scrolls?
keyPoints: Fixed boxes are removed from normal flow
Sticky boxes keep a flow position
Sticky behavior responds to a scroll threshold and container
questions.modelAnswer: A fixed box is normally anchored to the viewport and removed from normal flow. A sticky box keeps its place in flow and changes its constrained position after reaching an inset threshold within its scrolling context.
questions.explanation: Fixed and sticky use different flow and scrolling behavior.
questions.explanationAr: fixed بتخرج من التدفق وبتتعلق غالبًا بالـ viewport، أما sticky فبتفضل في التدفق.

questions.question: Why can a large descendant z-index fail to cover another element?
keyPoints: z-index is evaluated within stacking contexts
A context paints as a group against sibling contexts
Descendants cannot escape their ancestor context
The ancestor's stack level may be lower
questions.modelAnswer: A stacking context is painted as a group relative to sibling contexts, so a descendant's large z-index only orders it within that group. If the ancestor context is below another context, the descendant cannot rise above it by increasing its own value.
questions.explanation: Stacking contexts constrain descendant layering.
questions.explanationAr: سياق التكديس بيحصر ترتيب أبنائه، فالقيمة الكبيرة للابن مش بتعدي سياق الأب.

questions.question: What does normal flow mean, and what changes when a box leaves it?
keyPoints: Normal flow is the default document layout
Static and relative boxes retain flow participation
Absolute and fixed boxes leave normal flow
Other boxes lay out without reserving the removed box's space
questions.modelAnswer: Normal flow is the ordinary arrangement of boxes in the document, with static and relative elements still participating. Absolute and fixed positioning remove a box from that flow, so surrounding layout does not reserve its former space.
questions.explanation: Flow participation determines how an element affects neighboring layout.
questions.explanationAr: المشاركة في التدفق بتحدد إذا العنصر بيحجز مساحة وبيأثر على ترتيب العناصر حواليه.
